# PathPort (https://getpathport.com)

> PathPort is the universal credential and career platform built for everyone—if you have a credential, you can track it. Across technology, project management, aviation, trades, education, finance, public safety, and healthcare, PathPort keeps every license, digital badge, CE hour, case study, and personal identity document (Driver’s License, Passport, Global Entry) in one private record you own—then turns your work into tailored **MyPortfolio** links and maps your next career move with **MyPath**.

## Brand & Product Hierarchy
- **PathPort Individual (Fall 2026 Beta)**: The sovereign professional record, 50-state + national board CE renewal tracker (smart-suggesting matching requirement buckets for user confirmation), and encrypted document vault.
- **PathPort Free Identity & Workplace Profile ($0)**: Free personal identity document tracker (Driver’s License, Passport, Global Entry / TSA PreCheck, Vehicle Registration) with renewal reminders, plus free employee profile sharing for **PathPort Workplace** requests.
- **MyPortfolio (Module inside PathPort)**: Shareable, revocable portfolio links (`getpathport.com/p/yourname`) with 3 built-in visual themes (`Modern`, `Executive`, `Minimal`), QR codes, and attached credential proof.
- **MyPath (Module inside PathPort)**: 6-pillar career roadmap, deterministic "What-If" role readiness audits, and an Application & Interview Studio (tailored resumes, cover letters, and STAR interview prep grounded in your real work).
- **PathPort Workplace (Launching 2027)**: Built for any workforce that needs to obtain and verify employee credentials without sending countless emails. Simply log in, select the required credentials, and send the request to the employee—they create a free PathPort profile, upload their required docs, and share them instantly while system intelligence keeps everyone compliant. Also supports assigning CEUs and training credits directly to event attendees.
- **PathPort Certify (Launching 2027)**: End-to-end credential management for certifying bodies, associations, and credentialing organizations across any industry: allow candidates to apply for a credential, submit documents, and track payments; track exam results from official test platforms (or use our testing partners to streamline the experience); issue credentials from PathPort Certify through any badge provider (Credly, Accredible, Badgr, Open Badges) and with `Issuer-Verified` provenance in PathPort; and manage recertifications directly within the PathPort platform.

## 60-Second Onboarding & Multi-Channel Intake
1. **Resume / CV & LinkedIn PDF Import**: Upload your resume or LinkedIn profile export to extract roles, degrees, licenses, and accomplishments into a review staging workspace.
2. **Credly, Accredible & Digital Badge Network Import**: Paste individual badge URLs or your full Credly earner profile (`credly.com/users/you/badges`), Accredible (`credential.net`), Badgr / Canvas Credentials, Coursera, or Open Badges 2.0/3.0 links to bulk-import and verify digital credentials.
3. **Bulk CE Certificate Extraction**: Drop up to 20 CE PDFs or images at once to extract provider names, contact hours, dates, and mandatory topic categories.
4. **Email-to-Vault Forwarding (`ce-you@in.getpathport.com`)**: Forward course completion receipts from your inbox directly to your private PathPort intake address for automatic parsing.
5. **Research & Technical Imports**: Sync publications via PubMed, ORCID, DOI, Google Scholar, or BibTeX, and import technical repositories via GitHub or OSF.

## The 6 Action Pillars of PathPort
1. **Earn (Credentials & Licenses)**: Multi-state licenses, eNLC compact privileges, specialty board certifications (ANCC, AACN CCRN, NREMT, IBSC FP-C, PMI PMP, AHVAP CVAHP, CISSP), and BLS/ACLS/PALS cards.
2. **Learn (Continuing Education & Mandatory Topics)**: State-specific contact hours and mandatory topic buckets across all 50 US states + DC, NREMT NCCP 2025 (National, Local, Individual), and PMI Talent Triangle PDUs.
3. **Build (Applied Deliverables & Toolkits)**: Clinical protocols, simulation curricula, technical architectures, EHR order sets, and capstone deliverables.
4. **Demonstrate (Structured Case Studies)**: Challenge-Approach-Outcome case studies linked directly to the credentials and skills used.
5. **Experience (Roles, Preceptorships & Rotations)**: Charge leadership, flight/transport logs, clinical rotations, and program management history.
6. **Reflect (Publications, Speaking & Debriefs)**: Conference posters, peer-reviewed papers, committee leadership, and quality improvement debriefs.

## Pricing & Free Trial Policy
- **PathPort Essentials ($9.99/mo or $8.33/mo billed annually)**: Sovereign professional record, multi-state & national board CE renewal tracking, Email-to-Vault (`@in.getpathport.com`), encrypted document vault, and 1 public **MyPortfolio** link.
- **PathPort Pro ($19.99/mo or $16.66/mo billed annually)**: Everything in Essentials plus unlimited tailored **MyPortfolio** links, **MyPath** 6-pillar career roadmap, "What-If" role gap analysis, and Application & Interview Studio.
- **Free Trial Policy**: Every new account starts with a free trial of PathPort Pro with no credit card required (30 days for founding beta members). Veritas Technology Solutions, LLC never sells personal credential data or runs third-party ads.
